payload.text: `--profile <name>`: held until hv asks for it directly. `--profile <path>` is the specified interface (lib/cmd/infra, help infra, infra-profile.bats), and a name form needs a lookup rule nobody has written; a peer relaying hv's ask is not hv asking. hv asked on 2026-10-14 what building it involves; vc answered (a bare word resolves to <project root>/profiles/<name>/infra.yaml with the directory overridable, a path stays a path, one issue for cc), and hv parked it to come back to. Held until hv says build it or close it.
